name: skill-router
description: File-aware skill auto-routing: a PostToolUse hook injects one additionalContext directive to load the relevant best-practice skill(s) when you edit a matching file (PHP/Laravel/Blade, React/Vue/Inertia/Livewire via .tsx/.jsx/.vue, plain .ts/.js/.py/.go/.rb/.rs, SQL and migrations with engine-aware MySQL/MariaDB/PostgreSQL rows, components, tests, Dockerfiles, OpenAPI), a SessionStart hook primes a repo-tailored skill index, and low-confidence content signals flush as one digest on your next prompt (SessionEnd keeps the ledger). Every relevant skill co-fires per edit; fail-open, once per skill per session.
